scripts.db:apply:local: wrangler d1 execute tabs-db --local --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute tabs-db --local --file=./seed.sql
scripts.db:apply:remote: wrangler d1 execute tabs-db --remote --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute tabs-db --remote --file=./seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate:local: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute tabs-db --local --file="$f"; done
scripts.db:migrate:remote: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute tabs-db --remote --file="$f"; done
